verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Relay issues Visa debit/credit cards with spend limits and ATM withdrawal limits, and covers international wire transfers, but there is no mention of foreign transaction fees, FX markup, or fee-free spending abroad on cards. Community evidence only discusses international wire pricing ($10/transfer), not card foreign-fee policy. Missing for 10: any documentation of foreign transaction fee waiver on cards, FX rates used, or independent confirmation of no hidden fees when spending/withdrawing abroad on a card.
